question.text: Which SAS thematic standard covers 'Promoting health care (including mental health) and sanitation; and making available safe drinking water'?

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 5.5 maps SAS 200 exclusively to 'Promoting health care (including mental health) and sanitation; and making available safe drinking water'. SAS 100 is hunger/poverty/malnutrition/inequality; SAS 500 is environment/climate; SAS 1300 is financial inclusion. The Trap: SAS 100 (A) is hunger/poverty/malnutrition. SAS 500 (C) is environment/climate/forest/wildlife. SAS 1300 (B) is financial inclusion. SAS 200 is the healthcare/sanitation/water standard. Cross-Exam Context: The SAS numbering appears in NISM XXIII alone — not in prior exams. Mis-mapping SAS numbers is one of the most common trap-distractor families in this exam. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Keep a laminated SAS-100-to-1600 mapping card on your desk; beneficiary registers, hospital records, and ANC/immunization lists are the canonical MoV triangulation set for SAS 200.
